text: dsh-darkplus-code 是一个面向 DSH 网页界面的代码块外观插件。它为聊天中的代码块应用 Dark+ 语法配色，并提供跟随正文、按比例缩放或固定像素值三种字号模式。插件在“设置→通用”加入外观设置行，可切换调色板与类型/函数强调色，也会显示正文、代码块和行内代码的字号读数。主机端通过同源路由保存设置到用户目录下的 JSON 文件，浏览器端负责样式更新；不需要 API Key 或外部账号。

dsh-darkplus-code applies Dark+ colors to DSH chat code and lets users size it to follow content, scale proportionally, or stay fixed. General settings provide palette and accent controls. Preferences persist in a user-directory JSON file through a same-origin route. No API key is needed.
我想让聊天里的代码块使用 VS Code Dark+ 配色。
DSH 的代码文字太小，能不能跟随正文设置变化？
Can I change the syntax colors and font sizing of code blocks in DSH chat?
dsh-darkplus-code 的功能「代码块主题与字号」：在 DSH 聊天代码块应用浅色或深色 Dark+ token 配色，并支持字号跟随正文、按比例缩放或固定像素值。
dsh-darkplus-code 的功能「外观设置行」：在通用设置中提供配色开关、类型/函数强调色选择和字号模式按钮，并显示正文、代码块与行内代码的字号读数。
dsh-darkplus-code 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 62 天；提交数 2；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-darkplus-code README · dsh-darkplus-code：VS Code **Dark+** syntax colors and font-size control for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) (`dsh`) code blocks.

DSH ships exactly two palettes (`light` / `dark`) and fixes code blocks at **11px**, so chat code does not follow the content font size you set in **Settings → General → Font size**. This plugin changes only the code blocks — nothing else in the interface is touched.

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

dsh-darkplus-code README · What it does：**1. Dark+ syntax colors**

Replaces the built-in code-block token palette with the VS Code Dark+ palette:

dsh-darkplus-code README · What it does：| Token | Dark | Light | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| keyword | `#c586c0` | `#af00db` | `public class`, `if`, `return` |
| constant | `#b5cea8` | `#098658` | `0f`, `10000`, `true` |
| string | `#ce9178` | `#a31515` | `"配置"` |
| comment | `#6a9955` | `#008000` | `// comment` |
| parameter | `#9cdcfe` | `#001080` | identifiers, locals |
| punctuation | `#d4d4d4` | `#1f1f1f` | `( ) { } ;` |
| link | `#4fc1ff` | `#0563c1` | markdown links |
| type / function | `#4ec9b0` | `#267f99` | `MapNpc`, `LateUpdate` |

dsh-darkplus-code README · What it does：Code block background `#1e1e1e` (dark) / `#ffffff` (light), foreground `#9cdcfe` (dark) / `#001080` (light).

**2. Font size that follows your font-size setting**

DSH sizes every other content font with `calc(base + var(--dsh-content-font-delta))` — headings grow when you raise the font size, code blocks do not. This plugin puts code blocks onto the same mechanism:

dsh-darkplus-code README · What it does：| Your DSH font size | Body text | Code block (default `follow` mode) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 12 | 12px | 10px |
| 14 | 14px | 12px |
| 17 | 17px | 15px |

**3. Its own settings row**

**Settings → General → Code block appearance**, placed next to the built-in font-size row:

dsh-darkplus-code README · What it does：- **Follow font size** (default) · **Ratio** · **Fixed** — plus `13 14 15 16 17` px presets
- **Type/function teal** or **function yellow** — shiki assigns both `entity.name.type` and `entity.name.function` to one variable, so they cannot differ; this picks which one wins
- Palette on/off
- A live readout (`body 17px · code 15px · inline 15px`)

Settings persist to `~/.dsh-darkplus-code/config.json`, so they survive restarts and port changes.

dsh-darkplus-code README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-darkplus-code
```

Use your real profile name (`desktop` for DSH Desktop, `web` for the web build). Then restart DSH — or reload the page after a profile patch reload — and open **Settings → General** to configure it.

To remove it:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> remove dsh-darkplus-code
```

dsh-darkplus-code README · Scope：This plugin writes **only** `--shiki-*` token variables, the two `--dsw-font-markdown-code*` font tokens, and code-block element rules under `.md-code-block` / `pre.shiki`. It does not touch any other `--dsw-alias-*` interface token, so background, borders, radii, glass effects and every other surface keep their current theme.

dsh-darkplus-code README · Why `!important`：DSH renders code through shiki's css-variables theme: each token span carries an inline `style="color:var(--shiki-token-*)"`. Measured against a live DSH instance, the variable itself resolves correctly on `<body>` while the span still computed to the inherited color, so a variable-only override does not always take effect. An author rule with `!important` is the one declaration that outranks an inline non-important style, so this plugin writes the resolved color on the span as well as rewriting the variable.

dsh-darkplus-code README · Compatibility：- DSH Desktop and the `web` profile.
- Verified against DSH `dsh-web-app` with the `shiki` css-variables theme and `.md-code-block` code surfaces.
- No host dependencies beyond the optional `webServer` service; without it the plugin still styles code blocks and simply cannot persist settings.
